subject: MedLumen: Demo availability & vendor onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@medlumen.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: MedLumen Procurement <procure@medlumen.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedLumen: demo availability & onboarding requirements

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Were excited to see Redwood in action, but two gating items came up on our side before we can confirm a full technical demo:

- Procurement needs a completed vendor security questionnaire (attached).
- Legal needs a signed (or negotiated) NDA. They prefer DocuSign for signatures.

Also, heads-up: our security lead who would normally attend the demo (Carlos Vega) is traveling next week and will be out of the office Nov 23-29. That means our earliest safe window for a full technical session would likely be the week of Dec 7 or later.

Question: is there any possibility of running a "demo-lite" first (architecture overview + redacted example logs, no customer data) while our procurement queue processes the questionnaire? If so, what would you need from us to enable that?

I've attached our vendor questionnaire (PDF) and looped in procurement. If you can send a redline of the NDA and a proposed timeline, we can triage internally.

Thanks,

Sophie Tran
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
MedLumen Health
Attachments: medlumen_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@medlumen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MedLumen: demo availability & onboarding requirements

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and for sending the questionnaire.

We can absolutely accommodate a two-step approach:

1) Demo-lite (architecture overview + redacted logs): we can prepare a sanitized walkthrough that uses synthetic data and a redacted architecture diagram. No customer PII will be shown. That can be delivered as a 30–45 minute session.

2) Full technical demo (live environment + Q&A): well hold this until the questionnaire + NDA are cleared by your procurement/legal team.

Action items from our side:
- Im attaching a redline of the NDA (NDA_Redline_MedLumen_20261118.pdf) with one small data residency clarification. If youd prefer DocuSign, we can push it there.
- Ben, can you prepare a demo-lite deck and a short README for the sanitized environment (what will/won't be shown)?
- Aditya, Ill need a HubSpot link and a DocuSign option for the NDA so MedLumen can sign.

Proposed tentative full-demo windows after Carlos returns: Dec 7–9 OR Dec 14–16. If the earlier window works well prioritize that. If procurement timeline slips, we can run the demo-lite in the interim.

Sophie — would you prefer we schedule the demo-lite next week or wait until procurement starts the questionnaire review?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: NDA_Redline_MedLumen_20261118.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MedLumen: demo availability & onboarding requirements

Looping in a quick procurement note:

- Our policy is were happy to run a non-production "demo-lite" without a fully completed questionnaire, but our security team will not enable any production-like keys or customer-data paths until the questionnaire is returned and reviewed.
- To keep momentum, we can provide a time-limited evaluation API key (sandbox, 50k tokens) and a pre-recorded walkthrough showing model behavior on synthetic data. That typically satisfies product/engineering groups while procurement processes the paperwork.

Ive created a HubSpot deal (linked below) and will push the NDA to DocuSign if Marissa confirms the redline is acceptable.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4832
DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABCDEFG12345

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@medlumen.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: MedLumen Procurement <procure@medlumen.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MedLumen: demo availability & onboarding requirements

Thanks, Marissa and Aditya — this is helpful. Quick update from our side:

- Procurement confirmed they need the completed questionnaire returned before they will provision external vendor environments.
- Carlos (security) remains OOO Nov 23–29; procurement also has a partial freeze through Nov 30 while the month-end audit completes.

Given that, were going to pause scheduling a full technical demo until the questionnaire is completed and the NDA is finalized. Wed appreciate the redlined NDA in DocuSign format and the demo-lite instructions that you mentioned (README + any sandbox setup steps).

Tentative reschedule window: Dec 14–16 (our team has internal travel Dec 7–11). If you can send the DocuSign link and the demo-lite materials, well prioritize returning the questionnaire and signing the NDA as soon as procurement re-opens.

Thanks again for working with us on the sequence — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,

Sophie Tran
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
MedLumen Health
Attachments: medlumen_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (again), calendar_ics_stub.ics
